messages.subject: Re: MSA draft for review
messages.text:
Dear Oliver,

Thank you for your patience. Our redline is attached. To summarize, we have accepted your positions on payment terms (net 30) in Section 4 and on the non-solicitation period in Section 9.

Two points remain open and we need your decision:

1. Section 7.2, Limitation of Liability. Your draft caps liability at 1x the fees paid in the prior 12 months. Our policy requires a cap of 2x annual fees for any vendor with access to shipment data.

2. Section 11.3, Intellectual Property. We require assignment of all deliverables, including the prompt library and the evaluation harness built for us. We would like to sign before our operating committee meets on October 20, so a response by Wednesday, October 14 would be appreciated.

Kind regards,

Helena Brandt
Senior Counsel, Ostrander Logistics Inc.
